layout: ZIP_STORED; one member per manifest record at its relative_path; sorted names; timestamps 1980-01-01; no directory entries or extra fields
integrity: Every member is byte-identical to the Zenodo ZIP member named in data_manifest.json and is re-verified against that manifest (bytes, SHA-256, format, dimensions). Zenodo remains the source of record and the fallback.
